name: Employment and Skills Service (employment support)
whoFor: Kirklees residents out of work, or in work and wanting to progress.
eligibility: Out of work, or in work and wanting to progress
referralRoutes: Online enquiry form on My Kirklees ('Make an enquiry to Employment and Skills Support'): https://my.kirklees.gov.uk/service/Jobs_and_training___Make_an_enquiry_to_Employment_and_Skills_Support

selfReferral.note: Refer yourself by phone, email or the online enquiry form

projects.name: Employment support
projects.overview: Advisers help you get past what's stopping you working, then find and apply for jobs: CVs, interview practice and a plan. Also helps people in work who want to move up or change jobs.

provenance.source: Kirklees additional services spreadsheet v3 (October 2026), row 14; enquiry form link from the Employment Kirklees flyer (Word document, 11 Oct 2026)
provenance.evidence: Page changed Aug 2025; council Armed Forces page (Oct 2026) still refers to it. Also runs the care-leaver strand of Connect to Work. WYCA's 'Finding a job' form is passed to this service in Kirklees (confirmed by Phil Longworth, 10 Nov 2026).

listing.reason: On the live list since the October 2026 import, before the development team review.
